feature_clock.entry_and_exit_reference: Observed raw minute open; no guaranteed fill or contemporaneous execution entitlement
feature_clock.sessions: Actual XNYS opens/closes; retained DST and early-close calendar; no generated bars

signals.current_hours: All60 valid unique stock and SPY minutes in [open,open+60min)
signals.activity: Sum(minute close * minute volume), a raw dollar-activity proxy
signals.activity_refinement: Pre-outcome replacement of original memo share-volume comparison for cross-session split-unit consistency; original memo retained
signals.history: Immediately previous20 consecutive exchange-session complete stock opening hours; no skipping missing sessions
signals.activity_gate: Current dollar activity strictly greater than prior20 median
signals.relative_return: log(stock opening-hour C/O) - log(SPY opening-hour C/O)

cash_policy.risk_distance: Known opening-hour raw H-L; sizing proxy, not stop or guaranteed loss limit
cash_policy.quantity: Whole shares; floor(0.005*NAV/(H-L)); reduce for fee-inclusive20%NAV and unreserved settled-cash budgets using signal C
cash_policy.reservations: Fixed per-order planned notional plus buy fee; total never exceeds settled cash
cash_policy.fill: At observed10:46 open quantity may only decrease to fit original reservation and remaining settled cash; zero affordability cancels without replacement
cash_policy.settlement: Reuse frontier.historical_settlement.build_settlement_indices(sessions,'USD'); same bank/exchange T+3/T+2/T+1 model; no unsettled sale reuse
cash_policy.holding: Independent same-session two-hour positions, no short, margin, overnight, stop/target or trailing exit

missing_data.opening_or_warmup: Causal abstention, retained in source/candidate denominators
missing_data.planned_entry: Missing required price invalidates account; no convenient candidate replacement
missing_data.held_exit: Missing required price retains unresolved position and invalidates account; no future exit availability selection
missing_data.held_intermediate_minute: No invented bar; valuation can carry last observed price with explicit age
missing_data.source_identity_or_transport: Root adapter retains explicit failure and prevents qualified outcome claims

valuation.marks: Every observed held-symbol minute-close boundary plus exact entry/exit opens and post-fee marks, with session-open/close cash marks
valuation.unobserved_other_position: Carry only its valuation price; report stale-position count and age
valuation.drawdown: Sampled-mark maximum drawdown, not intrabar maximum loss
valuation.exposure: Integrate marked held-value/NAV over regular-session elapsed seconds

references.event: Same current/hour/warmup/activity/nonzero-range eligibility without arm sign/location tests; unfunded gross10:46-to12:46 event return
references.event_aggregation: Equal matched stocks within each date, then equal dates; unavailable dates are not zero
references.denominators: Retain eligible events, separate missing entry/exit, matched events and matched dates; no reranking

report: Sampled intraday drawdown and stale valuation ages
Weekly, monthly and yearly stability with continuous period-to-period capital
Explicit raw same-session price convention beside inherited shared cost metadata
limitations: Six surviving purposive pilot stocks, not a broad historical universe or final strategy universe
Provider historical revisions and session-asof ticker mapping do not establish original publication vintage or independently verified issuer identity
Dollar activity reduces split-share-unit inconsistency but is a proxy, not exact traded notional or corporate-action completeness
Minute reference prices and declared costs are simulations, not measured executable fills
Current Moomoo tariff counterfactual and40bps sensitivity are not historical realized fees
No model fitting, parameter sweep, source-driven name replacement or promotion

automation.source_gate: All2514 source audits complete before any strategy account
automation.same_definition_reruns: Reuse committed accounts only under identical source inputs, including invalid and failed accounts; preserve all attempts
